body: Fix spec android-macos-e2e-fixes, live confirmation and phases 4 to 6.U+000AU+000ALive, on the plain macOS build (accessibility reads only; owner-approved; watchdog armed):U+000AU+002D At 1280x860, opening Settings logs "Failed to update ui::AXTree, error: 88 will not be in the tree and is not the new root" (accessibility_bridge.cc:114, 36 times in one run), and the tree keeps the previous screen's 51 nodes.U+000AU+002D At 1280x1060, Settings reaches the tree (88 nodes, with Daily reminder, Text size and the rest).U+000AU+002D With the month picker open, the tree is byte-identical to the calendar's.U+000AU+002D Run 1 was stopped correctly by the watchdog on owner mouse movement. Run 2 ended cleanly.U+000AU+000AOwner decisions (15 lines) are in docs/specs/android-macos-e2e-fixes.decisions.md; recorded as decision 01M3JSK5SEP063FR2XA0SK6N0F. Two added after it:U+000AU+002D the pre-mortem guards all four failure modes (looks different, something that worked broke, tests pass but the device fails, tests bent to pass);U+000AU+002D Settings rows shrink the node to the 48 dp button, and photo placement uses line stops everywhere (Add memory and paste included).U+000AU+000AStep plan drafted: 35 Steps in 12 groups that ship together.U+000AU+002D The Musts ship alone: screen-reader (MB1 then H1), reminders (MB2 lifetime, permission state, row clock), composer focus (H5), capture cleanup (C8 recorders, then the Delete all and Reclaim sweep).U+000AU+002D Then the areas: editor input, photos, shell and settings accessibility, composer layout, media, cosmetics.U+000AU+002D Keyboard focus comes last, ordered after every Step sharing its files.U+000AU+000ANext: the phase 7 read-back for owner approval.
